product_overview: SKV POS is a professional Point of Sale and shop management system with multi-role access (Super Admin, Shop Admin, Cashier, Stock Keeper, Sales). It provides POS sales flow, bill management with pay-debt and notes, product/inventory management, customer and debt tracking, and reporting (dashboard, ABC, RFM, inventory valuation). Frontend runs at localhost:5173, backend API at localhost:8000.
core_goals: Enable cashiers to complete sales at POS with multi-currency payment (LAK, THB, USD).
Manage orders and debt: view bills, pay debt, add notes, reprint, cancel.
Allow shop admins to manage products, categories, units, stock, and customers.
Provide dashboards and reports (sales, product performance, customer analytics, debt summary).
Enforce role-based access and persist authentication (JWT in localStorage).
key_features: Login with test credentials (admin / adminpassword); JWT stored in localStorage.
POS: product grid, cart, payment modal (LAK/THB/USD), checkout, print bill.
Bill Manager: filter orders, view details, pay debt (multi-currency), payment history, order notes, reprint, cancel.
Shop: dashboard, products CRUD, categories/units, customers, debts, reports, employees, settings.
POS Dashboard: KPIs, date range, payment method reports.
Route protection by role (RoleRoute); unauthenticated users redirected to /login.
user_flow_summary: User opens app → redirected to /login if not authenticated.
User logs in with admin/adminpassword → role determines default area (admin/shop/pos/stock/sales).
Cashier: /pos → add products to cart → select payment → complete sale → optional print.
Cashier: /pos/bills → filter orders → view/pay debt, add notes, reprint, cancel.
validation_criteria: Unauthenticated users cannot access protected routes; redirect to /login.
Login with valid credentials (admin/adminpassword) succeeds and persists across refresh.
POS: add to cart, choose payment method, complete sale; stock decreases; bill appears in Bill Manager.
Bill Manager: filters work; pay debt updates order; payment history and notes display correctly.
Shop reports and dashboard load without HTTP 500; numbers match API responses.
UI supports Lao/English labels and remains responsive.
